title: 第167章 怪不得别人说今年大环境不好
slug: 让我开早餐店我下午才营业
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

赵可儿没有过多解释，她翻了个白眼，双手抱胸靠在椅背上。

张莉在一旁嗤笑一声，“当然不是。我们做的是高端餐饮，讲究效率和标准化。你只要把送来的料包剪开，装进盘子里，放进微波炉定好时间就行了。”

王大龙在餐饮界摸爬滚打这么多年，第一次听到高端餐饮是这么个玩法。但他现在缺钱，家里还有两个孩子要养，房贷也催得紧。他深吸了一口气，用力搓了搓裤腿。

王大龙妥协道，“会的老板。那我也干得来。只要给工资就行。方便问下咱们这工资多少吗？”

赵可儿轻笑了一声，伸出四根手指。

“四千。”

王大龙瞪大眼睛道，“啊？四千？”

赵可儿皱起眉头，“有什么问题吗？”

“可是我之前在上个酒楼都是一万多的。”

王大龙嗓门不自觉提高看了，“我干了十年餐饮！我切墩的时候都比这个数高！你们这可是天玺小区的正门商铺，这地段，这装修，招主厨给四千？”

“上一份是上一份，这里是这里。”

赵可儿干脆地回答，直接把王大龙的简历翻过来，推到桌子边缘，“嫌少门在那边。你以为现在的餐饮好做吗？到处都在裁员。我们能提供一个工作岗位就已经很不错了。不愿意干就算了，后面还有人排队呢。”

王大龙被气笑了。他伸手抓起桌上的简历，转身就往外走。

走出天玺小区东正门。

热浪打在王大龙脸上。他站在宽敞的步道上，回头看着那个挂着“臻·颜晨宴”四个金光大字的高级招牌。黑底金字透着一股昂贵的气息。

王大龙摸出一包烟，抽出一根点上。青烟吐出，叹了口气。

“四千块。”

王大龙摇了摇头，满脸的苦涩，“哎，怪不得别人说今年大环境不好，这也太不好了啊。真是不应该冲动辞职的。”

王大龙垂头丧气地走向公交车站。

赵可儿丢下笔，端起旁边的冰咖啡喝了一口。

“这帮厨子，还以为现在是前几年呢，张口就是一万多。”

赵可儿冷哼一声，“下一个！”

门外等候的两个年轻人赶紧站起来，跑进店里。

两人一个留着黄毛，一个穿着紧身套装。两人一进门就开始东张西望，眼神里透着精明。一看就是油滑之辈。

两人拉开椅子坐下。

赵可儿看了看手里那两张简陋的表格。

“你们俩一起的？上面写着你们在电子厂干过？会做饭吗？”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Zhao Keer didn't explain too much. She rolled her eyes, folded her arms and leaned on the back of the chair.

Zhang Li sneered at the side, "Of course not. What we do is high-end catering, and we pay attention to efficiency and standardization. You just need to cut open the package of ingredients delivered, put it on a plate, put it in the microwave and set the time."

Wang Dalong has been working hard in the catering industry for so many years, and this is the first time he heard about the method of high-end catering.But now he is short of money, he has two children to raise at home, and his mortgage payment is also tight.He took a deep breath and rubbed his trouser legs vigorously.

Wang Dalong compromised and said, "Boss, I can do it too. Just pay me a salary. Can I ask how much our salary is?"

Zhao Keer chuckled lightly and stretched out four fingers.

"Four thousand."

Wang Dalong's eyes widened and he said, "Ah? Four thousand?"

Zhao Keer frowned, "Is there any problem?"

"But the last restaurant I went to paid more than 10,000 yuan."

Wang Dalong's voice rose unconsciously, "I have been working in catering for ten years! Even when I cut dice, it was higher than this! This is the front store of Tianxi Community. In this location and with this decoration, you pay four thousand to recruit a chef?"

"The last one is the last one, and this is here."

Zhao Keer answered simply, turned over Wang Dalong's resume and pushed it to the edge of the table, "Shao Shaomen is over there. Do you think catering is easy to do now? There are layoffs everywhere. If we can provide a job, it's already very good. Forget it if you don't want to do it, there are still people queuing up behind."

Wang Dalong laughed angrily.He reached out and grabbed the resume on the table, turned around and walked out.

Walk out of the east main gate of Tianxi Community.

The heat wave hit Wang Dalong's face.He stood on the spacious walkway and looked back at the high-end signboard with the four golden characters "Zhen·Yan Chenyan".The gold letters on a black background exude an expensive atmosphere.

Wang Dalong took out a pack of cigarettes, took out one and lit it.He breathed out the green smoke and sighed.

"Four thousand dollars."

Wang Dalong shook his head, with a bitter look on his face, "Hey, no wonder others say that the environment this year is not good. This is too bad. You really shouldn't resign impulsively."

Wang Dalong walked to the bus stop dejectedly.

Zhao Keer put down the pen, picked up the ice coffee next to him and took a sip.

"These cooks thought it was just a few years ago that they could ask for more than 10,000 yuan."

Zhao Keer snorted coldly, "Next one!"

The two young men waiting outside the door quickly stood up and ran into the store.

One of the two has yellow hair, and the other is wearing a tight suit.As soon as the two entered the door, they started to look around, with shrewd eyes.At first glance, he looks like a slippery person.

The two pulled out chairs and sat down.

Zhao Keer looked at the two simple forms in his hand.

"You two together? It says you worked in an electronics factory? Can you cook?"
